verificationTemplate:
VERIFICATION

I, the deponent above-named, do hereby verify that the contents of paragraphs 1 to {lastParagraph} of the above affidavit are true to my personal knowledge. No part of it is false and nothing material has been concealed therefrom.

Verified at {place} on this {date}.

Deponent
prompt_context: Draft an Affidavit of Identity (also called 'one-and-same person' affidavit, name affidavit, or KYC affidavit). This is a non-court document, executed before a Notary Public under the Notaries Act, 1952, or before an Oath Commissioner. Common purposes: (a) reconciling different spellings of name across documents (PAN vs Aadhaar vs school certificate); (b) confirming permanent address; (c) declaring change of name; (d) submitting to bank for KYC; (e) submitting to government department for verification. Executed on non-judicial stamp paper of value as per state (typically ₹10-₹100). STRUCTURE: (1) heading 'AFFIDAVIT' (no court cause-title since this is non-court); (2) 'Before the Notary Public, [city]' line; (3) deponent identification; (4) 'do hereby solemnly affirm and declare as under:'; (5) factual paragraphs; (6) name-reconciliation paragraph (if applicable); (7) purpose paragraph; (8) verification; (9) deponent signature; (10) notary attestation block. NEVER include any IPC reference — use BNS where relevant. False statements in affidavits attract BNS Section 229 (giving false evidence) / BNS Section 230 (fabricating false evidence) — same as IPC 191/192.
promptInstructions: Draft a non-court Affidavit of Identity for the purpose specified.
Open with 'AFFIDAVIT' centred at the top.
Below the heading, write 'Before the Notary Public / Oath Commissioner, {city}, {state}'.
Deponent identification: 'I, {deponent_name}, S/o / W/o {parentage}, aged about {age} years, by occupation {occupation}, resident of {address}, do hereby solemnly affirm and declare as under:'
Para 1: state the basic factual position relevant to purpose.

If purpose involves name variation: include a dedicated paragraph: 'I state that I am known by the following names in different documents: (a) [name 1] in [doc 1]; (b) [name 2] in [doc 2]; that all these names refer to one and the same person, i.e. me, the deponent herein.'
Include paragraphs referencing the documents (Aadhaar, PAN, passport, etc.) with their numbers if available.
Closing paragraph: 'That this affidavit is being made to be submitted to {intended_recipient} for the purpose of {purpose} and the same may kindly be accepted.'
Add a signature block for the deponent.
Add attestation block for Notary / Oath Commissioner with seal and register entry placeholder.
Do NOT include any IPC reference — if citing penalty for false affidavit, use BNS Sections 229-230.
Do NOT include court cause-title — this is a non-court document.
